title: The FineWeb Datasets: Decanting the Web for the Finest Text Data at Scale
authors: G. Penedo, H. Kydlíček, L. Ben Allal, et al. (8 authors)
before: Data recipes were described in papers but rarely released with their ablations.
problem: Everyone rebuilt the same filtering pipeline and could not compare choices.
breakthrough: Fifteen trillion tokens plus the ablation study behind every filtering decision, and an education-filtered subset.
why: It made data curation an open empirical science, and FineWeb-Edu showed filtering for educational value beats raw volume.
next: The standard open pretraining corpus for new model efforts.
inherits: Published ablations as part of a dataset release.
